system.name: AGS
system.one_liner: an algorithm-hardware co-design accelerator for 3D Gaussian Splatting SLAM using CODEC-assisted frame covisibility detection

components.name: DRAM
components.role: stores Frame Data, Gaussian Features, Gaussian Tables and GS Logging Table shared by all engines

components.name: Video CODEC
components.role: generates SAD values during motion estimation that are reused for frame covisibility detection

components.name: FC Detection Engine
components.role: extracts SAD values from the video CODEC and accumulates them into frame covisibility

components.name: Systolic Array
components.role: PE array for coarse-grained pose estimation

components.name: GS Array (Light)
components.role: lightweight Gaussian array for fine-grained pose refinement

components.name: On-chip Buffer
components.role: buffers data for the pose tracking engine

components.name: Gauss Buffer
components.role: buffers Gaussian data for an engine

components.name: Mapping Engine
components.role: performs Gaussian contribution-aware mapping with GPE array

components.name: GS Array
components.role: array of Gaussian Processing Elements (GPEs) for rendering

components.name: GS Logging Table / Update Unit
components.role: records Gaussian contribution information for key frames

components.name: GS Skipping Table / Comparison Unit
components.role: compares against logged contributions to skip non-contributory Gaussians in non-key frames

flows.what: Gaussian tables and GS logging table

content.key_idea: AGS is a hardware architecture with a dedicated FC (frame covisibility) detection engine feeding a pose tracking engine and a mapping engine that both reuse cross-frame similarity to cut redundant 3DGS computation.
content.reading_order: Left to right along the top DRAM bus, down into the FC Detection Engine, then into the two bottom engine blocks (tracking, then mapping).

summary: This figure gives the top-level hardware architecture of AGS, an algorithm-hardware co-designed accelerator for 3D Gaussian Splatting SLAM. A DRAM bus at the top holds shared data structures (frame data, Gaussian features, Gaussian tables, GS logging table) and connects to a video CODEC and a GPU. Below, an FC (frame covisibility) Detection Engine taps SAD values produced by the CODEC's motion estimation to quantify similarity between consecutive frames. This covisibility signal drives two engines: a Pose Tracking Engine built from a systolic array plus a lightweight GS array for coarse-then-fine pose estimation, and a Mapping Engine with a GPE array, an update unit and a comparison unit that log and reuse Gaussian contribution information to skip redundant computation. The diagram uses flat colored boxes, dashed engine-container borders, and lettered callouts matching the architecture section's prose.
summary_zh: 该图展示AGS硬件架构：DRAM总线连接视频CODEC与GPU，FC协同可见性检测引擎提取SAD值，驱动位姿跟踪引擎（脉动阵列+轻量GS阵列）与建图引擎（GPE阵列+更新/比较单元）复用跨帧相似性以减少冗余计算。
